# ChangeCost

> Private, unreleased 0.x offline contracts, lifecycle and normalized settlement CLI. Provider operations remain planned.

## Local skills

- [changecost-implement](.agents/skills/changecost-implement/SKILL.md): Implement a selected ChangeCost OpenSpec change from fresh main, safely reconcile matching prepared artifacts, and deliver minimum sufficient code with TDD, current docs and llms.txt.
- [changecost-prepare](.agents/skills/changecost-prepare/SKILL.md): Interactively select and review the next pending ChangeCost change against fresh main, code and current external evidence; reconcile its plan and GitHub issue, then offer a planning PR or scoped stash.
- [changecost-promote](.agents/skills/changecost-promote/SKILL.md): Create or update a ChangeCost PR to main and delegate its review, CI, and verified-fix loop. Use when the user asks to promote a verified branch or handle its PR findings; never merge or deploy.
- [changecost-verify](.agents/skills/changecost-verify/SKILL.md): Verify a ChangeCost change with scoped quality, defect-review, and documentation subagents, then commit and push the verified feature branch. Use after implementation or preparation, before promotion to a PR.
- [openspec-apply-change](.agents/skills/openspec-apply-change/SKILL.md): Implement tasks from an OpenSpec change. Use when the user wants to start implementing, continue implementation, or work through tasks.
- [openspec-archive-change](.agents/skills/openspec-archive-change/SKILL.md): Archive a completed OpenSpec change through the OpenSpec CLI, including its built-in main-spec synchronization. Use after implementation acceptance; never replace CLI operations with agent-written specs or manual folder moves.
- [openspec-explore](.agents/skills/openspec-explore/SKILL.md): Enter explore mode - a thinking partner for exploring ideas, investigating problems, and clarifying requirements. Use when the user wants to think through something before or during a change.
- [openspec-propose](.agents/skills/openspec-propose/SKILL.md): Propose a new change with all artifacts generated in one step. Use when the user wants to quickly describe what they want to build and get a complete proposal with design, specs, and tasks ready for implementation.
- [openspec-sync-specs](.agents/skills/openspec-sync-specs/SKILL.md): Sync delta specs from a change to main specs. Use when the user wants to update main specs with changes from a delta spec, without archiving the change.
- [openspec-update-change](.agents/skills/openspec-update-change/SKILL.md): Update an OpenSpec change by revising its existing planning artifacts and keeping them coherent with one another. Use when the user wants to revise a change's plan, fold new decisions into it, or reconcile its artifacts after an edit. Never edits code.
